description: This source file defines a comprehensive Compose UI for an Android application's settings sheet. It manages various device permissions, system settings, and app-specific configurations including notification forwarding, location sharing, sensor permissions, and other device access controls. The file features UI components, permission handling logic, and functions to query installed apps and system status related to device configuration.

classes.name: InstalledApp
classes.description: Data class representing an installed application with label, package name, and system app status.

methods.name: queryInstalledApps
methods.description: Queries installed launcher apps, recent notification packages, and resolves candidate packages for notification forwarding.

methods.name: resolveNotificationCandidatePackages
methods.description: Combines configured, launcher, and recent packages to determine valid notification candidate packages, excluding the current app.

methods.name: settingsTextFieldColors
methods.description: Provides color configuration for text fields within the settings UI.

methods.name: Modifier.settingsRowModifier
methods.description: Custom modifier to style settings rows with border and background.

methods.name: settingsPrimaryButtonColors
methods.description: Defines color scheme for primary action buttons.

methods.name: settingsDangerButtonColors
methods.description: Defines color scheme for danger-level buttons.

methods.name: openAppSettings
methods.description: Opens the application details settings screen.

methods.name: openNotificationListenerSettings
methods.description: Opens the notification listener settings screen, fallback to app settings if needed.

methods.name: hasNotificationsPermission
methods.description: Checks if notification posting permission is granted (API >= 33).

methods.name: isNotificationListenerEnabled
methods.description: Checks if notification listener access is enabled.

methods.name: hasMotionCapabilities
methods.description: Verifies presence of motion sensors like accelerometer or step counter.

methods.name: isAssistantRoleAvailable
methods.description: Checks if the device role 'Assistant' is available.

methods.name: isAssistantRoleHeld
methods.description: Checks if the device role 'Assistant' is currently held by the app.
